source: Beginner short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.en: Today I have to run an errand.
I want to buy bread, milk, and eggs.
I walk to the shop because it's close.

sentences.ar: بشوف ناس بعرفهم بالطريق وبسلم عليهم.
sentences.en: I see people I know on the way and greet them.
I buy everything and come back quickly.
